reports.title: Vattel's Droit des gens and Wolff's Jus gentium: the order of reuse
reports.summary: Vattel follows Wolff chapter by chapter: rank correlation 0.93 over 2,117 rows. Where he leaves Wolff.

reports.title: Obligation without a superior: Vattel's Essai between Wolff and Barbeyrac
reports.summary: Vattel answers Barbeyrac with Wolff's definition of obligation, but grounds it in the agent's own utility, a step Wolff had refused.
